items.meaning: SMTP response code indicating readiness to start TLS.
SMTP response code for a syntax error with no parameters allowed.
SMTP response code indicating TLS is not available due to a temporary reason.
Upon receiving a 454 response, the client must decide whether or not to continue the SMTP session.
items.constraint: must decide whether or not to continue the SMTP session
items.action: decide whether or not to continue
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: If the client receives the 454 response

items.meaning: A publicly-referenced SMTP server is prohibited from requiring STARTTLS to deliver mail locally.
items.constraint: MUST NOT require use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally
items.object: use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally

items.meaning: Any SMTP server may refuse to accept messages for relay based on authentication supplied during TLS negotiation.
items.constraint: may refuse to accept messages for relay based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation
items.object: to accept messages for relay based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: An SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may refuse to accept any messages for relay or local delivery based on authentication supplied during TLS negotiation.
items.constraint: may refuse to accept any messages for relay or local delivery based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation
items.object: to accept any messages for relay or local delivery based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation
items.condition: that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: A publicly unreferenced SMTP server may choose to require TLS negotiation before accepting any commands.
items.constraint: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may choose to require that the client perform a TLS negotiation before accepting any commands.
items.object: TLS negotiation before accepting any commands
items.condition: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: In the case where the server requires TLS before commands, the server SHOULD return the specified reply code.
items.constraint: the server SHOULD return the reply code
items.object: reply code
items.condition: In this case
items.exception: other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT

items.meaning: Reply code 530 indicates that a STARTTLS command must be issued first.
When the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension is used, the status code returned SHOULD be 5.7.0.
items.constraint: the status code to be returned SHOULD be 5.7.0
items.object: status code 5.7.0
items.condition: If the client and server are using the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension [RFC2034]

items.meaning: After receiving a 220 response to STARTTLS, the client MUST start TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands.
items.constraint: the client MUST start the TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands
items.object: TLS negotiation
items.condition: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command

items.meaning: The client SHOULD abort the connection if a failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake after issuing STARTTLS.
items.constraint: it SHOULD abort the connection
items.object: connection
items.condition: If, after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake

items.meaning: When the SMTP client is using pipelining, the STARTTLS command must be the last command in a group.
items.constraint: the STARTTLS command must be the last command in a group
items.object: last command in a group
items.condition: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920

items.meaning: After TLS handshake completion, both parties must immediately decide whether to continue based on achieved authentication and privacy.
items.constraint: After the TLS handshake has been completed, both parties MUST immediately decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved.
items.action: decide whether or not to continue
items.object: whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: SMTP client and server may decide to move ahead even if TLS negotiation ended with no authentication and/or no privacy.
If the SMTP client decides the authentication or privacy level is not high enough to continue, it should issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after TLS negotiation completes.
items.constraint: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete.
items.object: SMTP QUIT command
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: If the SMTP server decides the authentication or privacy level is not high enough to continue, it should reply to every SMTP command from the client other than QUIT with 554.
items.constraint: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue, it SHOULD reply to every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code.
items.object: every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: Upon completion of TLS handshake, SMTP protocol is reset to initial state, the state after a server issues a 220 service ready greeting.
The server must discard any knowledge obtained from the client that was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: The client must discard any knowledge obtained from the server that was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.constraint: The client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself.
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: The client should send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation.
items.constraint: The client SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation.
items.object: an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation
items.condition: after a successful TLS negotiation

items.meaning: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake may be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake.
items.constraint: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake MAY be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake.
items.action: be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.object: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake
items.condition: received after the TLS handshake

items.meaning: A particular SASL mechanism might not be advertised unless a client has sent an appropriate client certificate during a TLS handshake.
客户端与服务器都必须知道当前是否有活动的 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: Both the client and the server MUST know if there is a TLS session active.
items.object: if there is a TLS session active

items.meaning: 若 TLS 会话已处于活动状态，客户端不得尝试启动 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: A client MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active.
items.action: attempt to start a TLS session
items.object: TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后收到的 EHLO 命令，服务器不得在其响应中返回 STARTTLS 扩展。
items.constraint: A server MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed.
items.object: the STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: STARTTLS 在 Submission 端口上使用时是有效的 ESMTP 扩展（按 RFC2476 定义）。
SMTP 不是端到端机制，客户端与服务器之间的 TLS 隐私不覆盖从发件方到收件方的传输。
SMTP 服务器能够认证 SMTP 客户端，并不意味着客户端收到的邮件在客户端处已被认证。
SMTP 客户端与服务器都必须检查 TLS 协商结果，以确认是否达到可接受的认证与隐私程度。
items.constraint: Both the SMTP client and server must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved.
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端应当仔细注意 TLS 协商的结果
items.constraint: should note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation
items.action: note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation
items.object: result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 在协商未获得隐私、算法或密钥长度不够强、或认证不充分时，客户端可以选择以立即 QUIT 命令结束 SMTP 会话
items.constraint: the client may choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.action: choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.object: SMTP session
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 在同样情形下服务器可以选择不再接受任何更多 SMTP 命令
items.constraint: the server may choose to not accept any more SMTP commands
items.action: choose to not accept any more SMTP commands
items.object: SMTP commands
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 服务器的“250 STARTTLS”响应被删除即可发起中间人攻击，使客户端不去尝试启动 TLS 会话
为防御此类攻击，客户端与服务器必须能够被配置为：在消息成功传输之前，针对选定主机要求成功的、具有适当密码套件的 TLS 协商
items.constraint: both clients and servers MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred
items.action: be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite
items.condition: for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred

items.meaning: 还应当提供在可能时使用 TLS 的附加选项
items.constraint: The additional option of using TLS when possible SHOULD also be provided
items.object: additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现可以提供记录与某对端通信时使用了 TLS、并在后续会话未使用时产生警告的能力
items.constraint: An implementation MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.action: provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning
items.object: ability to record TLS usage and generate a warning
items.condition: if it is not used in a later session

items.meaning: 若 TLS 协商失败或客户端收到 454 响应，客户端必须决定下一步如何做
在出现失败或错误时，客户端应在后续会话中重试 TLS，直至本地选定的超时发生，届时应将邮件退回发件人
items.constraint: the client should return the mail to the sender
items.action: return the mail to the sender
items.object: mail
items.condition: until some locally-chosen timeout occurs, at which point

items.meaning: 若客户端与服务器仅将 TLS 用于认证，客户端可能希望继续 SMTP 会话（以防服务器仍接受其未认证的部分操作）
items.constraint: the client may want to proceed with the SMTP session
items.object: SMTP session
items.condition: if the client and server were only using TLS for authentication

items.meaning: 在 TLS 握手开始之前，任何协议交互都以明文进行，可能被主动攻击者修改
客户端与服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃 TLS 握手开始之前获得的一切知识
items.constraint: clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.object: knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: STARTTLS extension is not suitable for authenticating the author of an email message unless every hop in the delivery chain, including submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated.
items.constraint: not suitable for authenticating the author of an email message unless every hop in the delivery chain, including the submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated

items.meaning: SMTP-AUTH proposal can be used to authenticate delivery.
MIME security multiparts can be used to authenticate the author of an email message.
SMTP-AUTH proposal offers simpler and more flexible options to authenticate an SMTP client.
SASL EXTERNAL mechanism MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity.
items.constraint: MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity
items.object: in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity

items.meaning: This document defines an SMTP extension.
SMTP client may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server, perform an authentication protocol exchange, and optionally negotiate a security layer during this session.
items.constraint: may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server, perform an authentication protocol exchange, and optionally negotiate a security layer for subsequent protocol interactions during this session
items.object: an authentication mechanism to the server

items.meaning: This SMTP extension includes a profile of SASL for SMTP.
An SMTP client may indicate an authentication mechanism to the server and perform an authentication protocol exchange.
An SMTP client may optionally negotiate a security layer for subsequent protocol interactions during this session.
During a mail transaction, an SMTP client may optionally specify a mailbox associated with the identity that submitted the message to the mail delivery system.
This document deprecates use of the 538 response code.
This document adds a new Enhanced Status Code.
This document adds a requirement to support the SASLprep profile for preparing authorization identities.
This document recommends use of RFC 3848 transmission types in the Received trace header field.
This document clarifies interaction with the SMTP PIPELINING extension.
The key words in this document are to be interpreted as described in [KEYWORDS].
The AUTH EHLO keyword contains as a parameter a space-separated list of the names of available SASL mechanisms.
The list of available mechanisms may change after a successful STARTTLS command.
items.constraint: MAY change after a successful STARTTLS command [SMTP-TLS]
items.object: list of available mechanisms
items.condition: after a successful STARTTLS command [SMTP-TLS]

items.meaning: AUTH 是添加到 MAIL FROM 命令的可选参数关键字，并把 MAIL FROM 命令的最大行长扩展 500 个字符。
MAIL FROM 命令的最大行长被扩展 500 个字符。
initial-response 是可选的初始客户端响应。
items.constraint: If present, this response MUST be encoded as described in Section 4 of [BASE64] or contain a single character "=".
items.action: encoded as described in Section 4 of [BASE64] or contain a single character "="
items.object: initial-response
items.condition: If present

items.meaning: AUTH 命令成功完成后，同一会话中不得再发出更多 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: After an AUTH command has been successfully completed, no more AUTH commands may be issued in the same session.
items.object: no more AUTH commands in the same session
items.condition: After an AUTH command has been successfully completed

items.meaning: 成功 AUTH 命令完成后，服务器必须用 503 回复拒绝任何后续 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: After a successful AUTH command completes, a server MUST reject any further AUTH commands with a 503 reply.
items.object: any further AUTH commands
items.condition: After a successful AUTH command completes

items.meaning: 在邮件事务期间不允许使用 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: not permitted during a mail transaction

items.meaning: 在邮件事务期间发出的 AUTH 命令必须用 503 回复拒绝。
items.constraint: An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction MUST be rejected with a 503 reply.
items.object: An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction
items.condition: issued during a mail transaction

items.meaning: AUTH 命令启动客户端与服务器之间的 SASL 认证交换。
客户端用 AUTH 命令的第一个参数标识要使用的 SASL 机制。
如果服务器支持所请求的认证机制，它就执行 SASL 交换以进行认证。
当请求的认证机制无效（例如不被支持或需要加密层）时，服务器会用 504 应答拒绝 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: the server rejects the AUTH command with a 504 reply if the requested authentication mechanism is invalid

items.meaning: 服务器支持 ESMTP-CODES 扩展时，应返回 5.5.4 增强响应码。
items.constraint: SHOULD return a 5.5.4 enhanced response code
items.object: a 5.5.4 enhanced response code
items.condition: If the server supports the [ESMTP-CODES] extension

items.meaning: 服务器挑战（334 应答的文本部分）不得含有除 BASE64 编码挑战之外的其他文本。
items.constraint: MUST NOT contain any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge
items.object: any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge

items.meaning: 如果服务器收到客户端用单个 "*" 取消认证交换的响应，就必须用 501 应答拒绝 AUTH 命令。
items.constraint: MUST reject the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply
items.object: the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply
items.condition: If the server receives such a response

items.meaning: AUTH 命令的初始响应参数是可选参数，用于在使用支持初始客户端响应的机制时省去一次往返。
如果省略初始响应参数且所选机制要求初始客户端响应，服务器就必须按 [SASL] 第 5.1 节的规定处理。
items.constraint: MUST proceed as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL]
items.object: as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL]
items.condition: If the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response

items.meaning: 如果使用初始响应参数会导致 AUTH 命令超出长度限制，客户端就不得使用该参数。
items.constraint: MUST NOT use the initial response parameter
items.object: the initial response parameter
items.condition: If use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length

items.meaning: A zero-length initial response is represented by a single equals sign ("=").
items.constraint: MUST instead transmit the response as a single equals sign ("=")
items.object: the response as a single equals sign ("=")
items.condition: If the client is transmitting an initial response of zero length

items.meaning: The server must reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply when the client uses an initial-response argument with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the authentication exchange.
items.constraint: MUST reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply
items.condition: If the client uses an initial-response argument to the AUTH command with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the authentication exchange

items.meaning: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension should return enhanced status code 5.7.0 in this case.
items.constraint: SHOULD return an enhanced status code of 5.7.0
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.7.0
items.condition: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES] ... in this case

items.meaning: The server must reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply and enhanced status code 5.5.2 if it cannot BASE64-decode a client response.
items.constraint: MUST reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply (and an enhanced status code of 5.5.2)
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply (and an enhanced status code of 5.5.2)
items.condition: If the server cannot [BASE64] decode any client response

items.meaning: The client must cancel authentication using the "*" response if it cannot BASE64-decode any server challenge.
items.constraint: MUST cancel the authentication using the "*" response
items.object: the authentication using the "*" response
items.condition: If the client cannot BASE64 decode any of the server's challenges

items.meaning: Servers and clients must reject any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet.
items.constraint: MUST reject (and not ignore) any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet
items.object: any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet
items.condition: In particular

items.meaning: BASE64 sequences containing the pad character anywhere other than the end must be rejected.
items.constraint: MUST reject any sequence of BASE64 characters that contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string
items.object: any sequence of BASE64 characters that contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string
items.condition: contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string

items.meaning: Clients and servers must handle the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms.
items.constraint: MUST be able to handle the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms
items.object: the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms

items.meaning: If a received line is longer than the server's authentication buffer during an authentication exchange, the server fails the AUTH command with the 500 reply.
Servers using the enhanced status codes extension should return enhanced status code 5.5.6 in this case.
items.constraint: SHOULD return an enhanced status code of 5.5.6
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.5.6
items.condition: using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES] ... in this case

items.meaning: 12288 octets is considered a sufficient line length limit for handling deployed authentication mechanisms.
客户端与服务端应使用 SASLprep/StringPrep 配置文件准备授权身份名称，以供传输或比较。
items.constraint: both client and server SHOULD use the [SASLprep] profile of the [StringPrep] algorithm to prepare these names for transmission or comparison
items.object: the [SASLprep] profile of the [StringPrep] algorithm to prepare these names for transmission or comparison

items.meaning: 如果授权身份的准备工作失败或结果为空字符串（除非它本身就是作为空字符串传输的），服务器必须使认证失败。
items.constraint: the server MUST fail the authentication
items.object: the authentication
items.condition: If preparation of the authorization identity fails or results in an empty string
items.exception: unless it was transmitted as the empty string

items.meaning: 本条注释说明：本规范的未来修订可能把该要求改为 MUST；当前使用 SHOULD 是为了避免破坏大多数现有实现。
如果服务器无法认证客户端，它应拒绝 AUTH 命令并返回 535 回复，除非有更具体的错误码适用。
items.constraint: it SHOULD reject the AUTH command with a 535 reply
items.object: the AUTH command with a 535 reply
items.condition: If the server is unable to authenticate the client
items.exception: unless a more specific error code is appropriate

items.meaning: 如果客户端成功完成交换，SMTP 服务器发出 235 回复。
若在 SASL 交换中协商了安全层，对客户端而言，它在客户端生成的最后一个响应结束的 CRLF 之后的第一个八位组起生效。
安全层生效时，SMTP 协议重置为初始状态（即服务器发出 220 服务就绪问候后的 SMTP 状态）。
安全层生效时，服务器必须丢弃从客户端获得、但并非来自 SASL 协商本身的知识（如 EHLO 参数）。
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client ... which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the EHLO argument, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: 同样地，安全层生效时，客户端必须丢弃从服务器获得、但并非来自 SASL 协商本身的知识（如 SMTP 服务扩展列表）。
items.constraint: the client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server ... which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: 客户端可以比较认证前后通告的 SASL 机制，以便检测主动降级攻击。
items.constraint: a client MAY compare the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication
items.object: the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication

items.meaning: SMTP 扩展命令，客户端在使能安全层的 SASL 协商成功后应作为第一条命令发送
items.constraint: 客户端在成功完成导致启用安全层的 SASL 协商后，应发送 EHLO 作为第一条命令
items.object: EHLO command as the first command
items.condition: after a successful SASL negotiation that results in the enabling of a security layer

items.meaning: TLS 编码层，在同时生效 TLS 与 SASL 安全层时须在 SASL 编码之后应用
items.constraint: 当 TLS 与 SASL 安全层同时生效时，TLS 编码必须在 SASL 编码之后应用，与协商顺序无关
items.object: the SASL encoding
items.condition: When an entity (whether it is the client or the server end) is sending data, and both [TLS] and SASL security layers are in effect

items.meaning: SASL 认证命令，其失败后客户端可继续未经认证或改用其他机制/凭据
items.constraint: AUTH 命令失败后，客户端可选择不经认证继续，或尝试另一认证机制或提交不同凭据
items.action: proceed without authentication or try another authentication mechanism or present different credentials by issuing another AUTH
items.object: AUTH command
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 服务器实现，必须实现不允许明文口令机制的配置（除有保护机制外）
items.constraint: 服务器实现必须实现一种不允许任何明文口令机制的配置，除非已协商 STARTTLS 或存在其他防止口令窥探的保护机制
items.action: implement a configuration in which it does NOT permit any plaintext password mechanisms
items.object: configuration
items.exception: unless either the STARTTLS [SMTP-TLS] command has been negotiated or some other mechanism that protects the session from password snooping has been provided

items.meaning: 服务器站点，不应使用在无口令窥探保护机制情况下允许明文口令机制的配置
items.constraint: 服务器站点不应使用允许明文口令机制而缺少防止口令窥探保护机制的配置
items.object: any configuration which permits a plaintext password mechanism without such a protection mechanism against password snooping

items.meaning: SASL PLAIN 机制，客户端与服务器实现必须在 TLS 之上实现它
items.constraint: 为保证互操作性，客户端与服务器实现必须在 TLS 之上实现 [PLAIN] SASL 机制
items.object: the [PLAIN] SASL mechanism running over TLS
items.condition: To ensure interoperability

items.meaning: 一种已有的 SASL 机制，许多现有客户端与服务器实现都实现了它，但不提供任何服务器认证
items.constraint: new implementations MAY implement it
items.object: CRAM-MD5 SASL mechanism
